name: service2
description: Holds the fixed, seeded catalog of ten scored records and serves it, as-is, to service1. Starts in full mode. Exposes an internal-only operations endpoint that switches it between full mode (all ten records) and empty mode (no records) — reachable only by an Internal Operator, never by an API Consumer and never through service1. Performs no computation over the records; averaging is service1's job.
